# DSH 插件社区

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件的**社区**——讨论、求助、展示、找方案。
> 市场负责「有什么插件」，这里负责「这个插件怎么样、怎么用、出问题找谁」。
**本仓库不是一个插件市场。** 它不托管插件、不提供安装器，只提供一个**人和插件作者能对话的地方**。
## 这里能做什么
| 我想… | 去哪 |

| 看看别人做了什么插件 | 🧩 插件展示 |
| 用某个插件卡住了 | 🙋 求助 |
| 想要一个还不存在的插件 | 💡 想法与需求 |
| 汇报插件的 bug | **优先去插件自己的仓库开 Is

sue**；找不到仓库、Issue 关着、或提了没人管 → 本仓库 Issues |
| 查某个插件已知的问题 | 🐞 已知问题 |
| 随便聊聊 | 🗣️ 闲聊 |
**为什么 bug 走 Issues 而不是 Discussions**：Issues 能关、能指派、能被作者订阅通知，是「待办」；Discussions 是「话题」，发完不一定要有人处理。**能用
而不是 Discussions**：Issues 能关、能指派、能被作者订阅通知，是「待办」；Discussions 是「话题」，发完不一定要有人处理。**能用 Issue 追踪的事不要开讨论帖。**
## 怎么参与
**浏览不需要登录。** GitHub 的公开 Discussions 对所有人可见——直接看就行。
**发言需要一个 GitHub 账号。** 这是唯一的门槛，也是本项目的刻意选择：把身份、反滥用、通知全都交给 GitHub，社区自己不做账号体系。

- 第一次来 → 先读 CONTRIBUTING.md
- 想推荐自己的插件 → 读 投稿指南
- 想汇报安全问题 → 读 SECURITY.md（**不要开公开 Issue**）
## 讨论分类
| 分类 | 用途 | 能标「答案」 |

| 📣 公告 | 索引更新、社区规则变更 | — |
| 🧩 插件展示 | 作者自荐，或推荐你用过的插件 | 否 |
| 🙋 求助 | 使用中遇到问题 | **是** |
| 💡 想法与需求 | 「我

想要一个能做 X 的插件」 | 否 |
| 🐞 已知问题 | bug 的汇总与绕行方案 | 否 |
| 🗣️ 闲聊 | 兜底 | 否 |
> **求助帖能标答案**这件事很重要：一个被解决了的问题会留在搜索结果里，下一个人搜到就能直接用。**解决了就请回来把答案标上。**
## 行为准则
参与即表示同意 CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md。一句话版本：**对插件苛刻，对人客气。**
## 与市场的关系
DSH 的插件市场已经不止一个，而且都做得不错。**社区不是第 N+1 个市场**，也不会去重复它们的索引工作。
社区做的是市场做不了的事：

- **对话**——市场能告诉你插件存在，不能告诉你它在你这种情况下会不会崩
- **沉淀**——一个被回答过的问题，比一次性的 star 数有用得多
- **作者与用户的直接接触**——插件作者能在

- **沉淀**——一个被回答过的问题，比一次性的 star 数有用得多
- **作者与用户的直接接触**——插件作者能在这里看到真实反馈
如果你在维护一个市场或索引目录，欢迎来闲聊区打个招呼——**我们更愿意合作而不是竞争**。
## English summary
**DSH Plugin Community** — a place for discussing DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugins: showcasing them, g
etting help, asking for new ones, and recording known issues.
**This repository is not a plugin marketplace.** It hosts no plugins and ships no installer. It exis
ts so that people and plugin authors have somewhere to talk.
### Where to go
| I want to… | Go to |

| See what plugins other people built | 🧩 Plugin showcase |
| Get unstuck on a plugin | 🙋 Ask for he

lp |
| Ask for a plugin that does not exist yet | 💡 Ideas & requests |
| Report a plugin bug | **Ope
n an issue in the plugin's own repository first.** No repo, issues closed, or nobody responding → th

is repository's Issues |
| Look up a known problem | 🐞 Known issues |
| Just chat | 🗣️ General |
**Why bugs go to Issues and not Discussions**: issues can be closed, assigned, and subscribed to by
the author — they are a to-do list. Discussions are topics; nobody is obliged to act on one. **Anyth
ing you want tracked should be an issue, not a discussion thread.**
### Taking part
**Browsing needs no account.** Public GitHub Discussions are visible to everyone — just read.
**Posting needs a GitHub account.** That is the only barrier, and it is deliberate: identity, abuse
prevention, and notifications are all delegated to GitHub. The community runs no account system of i
ion, and notifications are all delegated to GitHub. The community runs no account system of its own.

- First time here → read CONTRIBUTING.md
- Want to submit your own plugin → read the submission guid

e
- Reporting a security problem → read SECURITY.md (**never open a public issue for it**)
### Discussion categories
| Category | Purpose | Can accept an "answer" |

| 📣 Announcements | Index updates, rule changes | — |
| 🧩 Plugin showcase | Authors self-promoting,

or recommending a plugin you use | no |
| 🙋 Ask for help | Trouble using something | **yes** |
| 💡 I

deas & requests | "I wish a plugin could do X" | no |
| 🐞 Known issues | Bug round-ups and workaroun

ds | no |
| 🗣️ General | Everything else | no |
> **That help threads can accept an answer matters**: a solved question stays in search results, and
the next person finds it immediately. **Once yours is solved, come back and mark the answer.**
### Forms are bilingual
Every issue form and discussion form in this repository carries Chinese and English in the same fiel
d (`中文 / English`), so you can fill them in either language. GitHub has no per-language form support
, and shipping duplicate English forms would double the "new issue" list and let the two versions dr
ift apart — so both languages live in one form.
### Code of conduct
Participating means agreeing to CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md. The one-line version: **be exacting about plugin
s, be kind to people.**
